::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 26th [1866]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 156-157
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd),
I enclose the list of the other copies of the [Dove](cmy_books/cmybook_62.qmd) to be sent out besides my own dozen. Our day of departure is still fixed for Monday, but it is very likely to be put off till Friday. I suppose you naturally send copies of my books to the [Guardian](organizations/other_75.qmd) but it is odd how it has ceased to notice them.

If [Miss Keary](people/person_793.qmd)’s new [book](other_books/otherbook_465.qmd) is finished at the same time, I should be glad to have a copy in the parcel.

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
